title: feat(instantsearch): allow overriding the helper.search function

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @bobylito, @redox and @Jerskouille to be potential reviewers
cc @seafoox this is what you are looking for

Other possible "implementations" of this:
- create a instantsearch.search = function() {} that widget will need to call

But it would mean having to re-do our widgets and also might surprise our users.
This PR means that when you are using searchFunction, we will do a shallow clone of the helper at each keystroke (or search). Not a deep clone.
